_about: Per-metric change thresholds shared by the Nightly Kernel Checks page
(the THRESHOLDS constant in index.html, which test_kernel_checks_page.py
keeps equal to this file) and pr_report.py. A change of at least `pct`
percent of the previous value counts: the page colors it, the report lists
it. With `mad`, it must also exceed that many times the larger of the two
runs' median absolute deviations (the ± at the start of a row's range),
so a noisy case does not flag its own jitter. `gated` metrics are the
regressions a report leads with; a `derived` metric repeats another and is
not compared. Kernel object size excludes the harness and runtime image.
In two nightlies of one commit, cycles moved by well under 1%, npu_us by 17% at the
90th percentile on npu1, where one case's MAD was 21% of its median.
